field_map.mod: modification number ('0' = new award); dedup key = aid|mod|amt — an FPDS correction restating the action appends a NEW row (vintage record)
field_map.ad: action_date — when the action was SIGNED, never when the public could know it (see confidence_model)
field_map.amt: federal_action_obligation for this action (negative = deobligation, kept symmetrically)
field_map.r: recipient name as reported (raw, always kept)
field_map.pn: parent recipient name from the AWARD-DETAIL endpoint (the recipient-profile endpoint's parents are vintage-less and wrong — never used)
field_map.tkr: matched ticker or null — null = unmatched, SKIPPED by consumers, never fuzzy-guessed
field_map.mm: match method: cache | name | parent | null (gate-1 audit key)
field_map.mname: the exact normalized name string that produced the match (audit trail)
field_map.rt: as-seen date (UTC day WE fetched it) — the ONLY honest event date for returns math

confidence_model: as-reported FPDS records via nightly USAspending load. POINT-IN-TIME: civilian agencies surface ~1-4 days after action; DoD + USACE are withheld ~90 DAYS (verified 2026-07-05) — gate-2 work must exclude or separately cohort DoD, and 'knowable on day X' = filter rt <= X, never ad <= X. Ingest polls by last_modified_date so late publication and corrections land as new rows.
cadence: 6h poll over a 2-day last_modified_date window; EXPLICIT CAP (stated, never silent): award types A-D AND |amt| >= $25,000 — keeps 99.74% of positive obligated dollars in ~20% of rows (measured 2026-06-30, n=6,691), applied client-side via two sorted passes because the API's award_amounts filter is award-LIFETIME, not action size; dedup by (aid,mod,amt)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
